# Ex-Syndie
This secret identity modifier gives affected players a [bold]personal traitor cache.[/bold] Only non-traitors can have this modifier.
The cache can contain gear from any of the Traitor secret identities, including items that are strictly harmful to the crew, like the [textlink="Subverter's" link="Subverter"] subversion chip.
## Strategy Certainly, caution should be exercised when using these items, as crew is typically not-too-receptive towards traitors and extremely happy to kill anyone they percieve as one as soon as the chance arrives.
With that being said, traitor items can also have extreme utility to both you and the crew; passing up your cache entirely for the chance to not get killed would be a shame, considering correct utilization of traitor items can often lead to cheating death or confirming something that would otherwise be much more difficult to do without a traitor item.
Several secret identities also have soft-confirms within their abilities that make the chances of someone being an ex-syndie instead of a traitor much more likely. If there's heat on you, it's a good idea to leverage this when possible. Some examples of roles with (easily) applicable soft-confirms include [textlink="Arms Dealer" link="ArmsDealer"], [textlink="Cryojunkie" link="Cryojunkie"], and [textlink="VIP." link="VIP"]
It's also extremely possible to get by with your behavior alone; someone who is helpful to crew, hasn't been seen committing anything that could be seen as a traitorous act, or doing something that a specific secret identity might do can simply explain their way out of the situation, should they ever even find themselves in hot water under such conditions.
